claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for hemodynamically significant anemia (hemoglobin 7.4-8.3 g/dL) in the setting of cardiac disease and temporary pacemaker.
Continue invasive mechanical ventilation support and titrate oxygen to maintain adequate oxygenation (SpO2 92-97%, PaO2 >60 mmHg).
Monitor arterial blood pressure closely given diastolic hypotension (diastolic 23-37 mmHg, MAP 37-60 mmHg) and consider vasopressor adjustment.
Continue insulin infusion and monitor blood glucose frequently, targeting glucose 70-180 mg/dL (recent glucose 66-137 mg/dL).
Monitor and manage electrolyte abnormalities, including magnesium 2.3-2.8 mg/dL and potassium 3.7-4.7 mEq/L, with replacement as needed.
Continue amiodarone infusion for arrhythmia prophylaxis/treatment and monitor cardiac rhythm.
Monitor temporary pacemaker function and settings (rate 50-54 bpm, sensing/stimulation thresholds).
Obtain daily chest imaging to assess pulmonary status and line positions.
Perform tracheostomy care and oral care to prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia.
Assess and manage pain with multimodal analgesia, avoiding excessive sedation (current pain mild to moderate).
